_doc: Rows-open DRAM rate probe facts a die (#1186 family, analyzer rounds 76-83): the share of the die flat stream rate one SM gets with R rows open, by the schedule geometry (warps_k _ row sets). "curve": the stride4k probe at its 2720-B rows (request: its load width); "pitch": the stride4z / stride4q8 sweeps at the exam row pitches (key = row pitch in bytes). Points are [rows open an SM, share]. One card a die measured it.
